hooks.command: diff -q "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/packages/tauri-mcp/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (mkdir -p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/packages/tauri-mcp/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/" && cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && npm install --omit=dev --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund 2>/dev/null) || rm -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json"; if [ ! -L "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/packages/tauri-mcp/node_modules" ]; then rm -rf "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/packages/tauri-mcp/node_modules"; fi; ln -sfn "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/node_modules" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/packages/tauri-mcp/node_modules" 2>/dev/null
